title: Tabs
summary: A tab strip with optional panels. Children: pk-tab and pk-tab-panel paired by value. Arrow keys, Home and End move between tabs (roving tabindex). It can show no tab as selected, slide sideways with edge fades, and hold trailing content after the last tab.

props.name: value
props.description: The value of the selected tab. Empty selects the first enabled tab.

props.name: activation
props.description: auto selects a tab when arrow keys focus it; manual moves focus and waits for Enter or Space.

props.name: noneActive
props.description: No tab is shown as selected, and choosing any tab (even the last one chosen) raises pk-tab-change. For a page whose cross-cutting view sits above its tabs.

props.name: scroll
props.description: One row that slides (touch swipe, wheel, drag) when the tabs outgrow the width, with a fade at the edge that has more tabs, instead of wrapping onto more rows.

slots.name: tab
slots.description: pk-tab children (they assign themselves to this slot).

slots.name: panel
slots.description: pk-tab-panel children (they assign themselves to this slot).

slots.name: trailing
slots.description: Content inside the strip after the last tab: a hint, links or buttons.

events.name: pk-tab-change
events.description: A tab was chosen. Cancelable: preventDefault keeps the previous tab.

a11y: The strip has role=tablist; tabs and panels are related with aria-controls and aria-labelledby set on the light-DOM children (both live in the same tree, so the ids resolve). Roving tabindex: only the selected tab is in the Tab order (every tab when none is active); arrow keys move focus and skip hidden and disabled tabs.

examples.title: Tabs with panels
examples.html:
<pk-tabs value="details">
  <pk-tab value="details">Details</pk-tab>
  <pk-tab value="history">History</pk-tab>
  <pk-tab-panel value="details">Item details.</pk-tab-panel>
  <pk-tab-panel value="history">Item history.</pk-tab-panel>
</pk-tabs>
